# Hypothesis: Sparse MLP columns consistently stronger on the observed self-check motif than on matched reference arithmetic may nominate a selective causal intervention; this contrast alone is not causal evidence.
bad_npz = np.load("results/astra_clean_20261103/pass_02/text_0000_mlp.npz")
ref_npz = np.load("results/astra_clean_20261103/pass_02/text_0001_mlp.npz")
score_bad = np.load("results/astra_clean_20261103/pass_02/text_0000_scores.npz")
score_ref = np.load("results/astra_clean_20261103/pass_02/text_0001_scores.npz")
layer_rows = []
candidate_rows = []
all_arrays = {}
for layer in range(24):
    bfull = bad_npz[f"layer_{layer}"]
    gfull = ref_npz[f"layer_{layer}"]
    b = bfull[399:469]
    g = gfull[399:469]
    babs = np.abs(b).mean(0)
    gabs = np.abs(g).mean(0)
    pabs = np.abs(bfull[:399]).mean(0)
    delta = b.mean(0)-g.mean(0)
    pooled = np.sqrt(.5*(b.var(0)+g.var(0))+1e-8)
    effect = delta/pooled
    first = np.abs(b[:35]).mean(0)-np.abs(g[:35]).mean(0)
    second = np.abs(b[35:]).mean(0)-np.abs(g[35:]).mean(0)
    name = f"model.language_model.layers.{layer}.mlp.down_proj.weight"
    w = load_original(name)
    colnorm = torch.linalg.vector_norm(w,dim=0).numpy()
    score = np.maximum(babs-gabs,0)*colnorm
    ratio = babs/(gabs+1e-6)
    prefix_ratio = babs/(pabs+1e-6)
    eligible = (ratio>=1.5)&(prefix_ratio>=1.3)&(first>0)&(second>0)
    ranking = np.argsort(np.where(eligible,score,-1))[::-1]
    selected = [int(j) for j in ranking[:8] if eligible[j]]
    layer_rows.append({"layer":layer,"effect_l2":float(np.linalg.norm(delta)/(np.sqrt(.5*(b.var(0).sum()+g.var(0).sum()))+1e-8)),"prefix_relative_l2":float(np.linalg.norm(bfull[:399]-gfull[:399])/(np.linalg.norm(bfull[:399])+1e-8)),"eligible_neurons":int(eligible.sum()),"top8_contribution_score":float(score[selected].sum()),"top8_columns":selected})
    for j in selected:
        candidate_rows.append({"layer":layer,"column":j,"score":float(score[j]),"bad_mean_abs":float(babs[j]),"reference_mean_abs":float(gabs[j]),"bad_reference_ratio":float(ratio[j]),"bad_prefix_ratio":float(prefix_ratio[j]),"standardized_signed_effect":float(effect[j]),"first_half_abs_delta":float(first[j]),"second_half_abs_delta":float(second[j]),"weight_column_norm":float(colnorm[j])})
    all_arrays[f"layer_{layer}"] = np.stack([babs,gabs,pabs,delta,pooled,first,second,colnorm,score,eligible.astype(float)])
np.savez_compressed("results/astra_clean_20261103/tf_contrast_arrays.npz",**all_arrays)
candidate_rows.sort(key=lambda r:r["score"],reverse=True)
result = {"analysis_window":{"prefix_tokens":399,"continuation_tokens":70},"matched_logprob":{"observed_loop":float(score_bad["logprobs"][398:468].mean()),"reference":float(score_ref["logprobs"][398:468].mean())},"layer_effects":layer_rows,"top_candidates":candidate_rows[:24],"edits_applied":edited()}

# Hypothesis: Attenuating four layer-18 columns associated with the observed self-check motif will selectively reduce its likelihood; norm and loop-activity matched nonselective columns provide a fixed control.
selected_columns = [1261,1405,1824,1784]
layer18 = all_arrays["layer_18"]
babs18, gabs18, norms18 = layer18[0], layer18[1], layer18[7]
control_pool = [int(j) for j in range(3584) if j not in selected_columns and abs(np.log((babs18[j]+1e-8)/(gabs18[j]+1e-8))) <= np.log(1.1)]
control_columns = []
control_matches = []
for target in selected_columns:
    candidates = [j for j in control_pool if j not in control_columns]
    distances = [float(np.log((norms18[j]+1e-8)/(norms18[target]+1e-8))**2 + np.log((babs18[j]+1e-8)/(babs18[target]+1e-8))**2) for j in candidates]
    control = candidates[int(np.argmin(distances))]
    control_columns.append(control)
    control_matches.append({"target":target,"control":control,"target_norm":float(norms18[target]),"control_norm":float(norms18[control]),"norm_relative_deviation":float(norms18[control]/norms18[target]-1),"target_loop_mean_abs":float(babs18[target]),"control_loop_mean_abs":float(babs18[control]),"activity_relative_deviation":float(babs18[control]/babs18[target]-1),"control_loop_reference_ratio":float(babs18[control]/gabs18[control])})
weight_name = "model.language_model.layers.18.mlp.down_proj.weight"
original_weight = load_original(weight_name)
variant_results = []
for variant,alpha,columns in [("alpha025",.25,selected_columns),("alpha050",.5,selected_columns),("alpha100",1.,selected_columns),("control100",1.,control_columns)]:
    weight = original_weight.clone()
    weight[:,columns] = (1-alpha)*original_weight[:,columns]
    save_edit(weight_name,weight)
    np.save("results/astra_clean_20261103/variants/"+variant+"/"+weight_name+".npy",weight.numpy())
    np.save("results/astra_clean_20261103/deltas/"+variant+"/"+weight_name+".npy",(weight-original_weight).numpy())
    variant_results.append({"variant":variant,"alpha":alpha,"columns":columns,"relative_weight_norm_change":float(torch.linalg.vector_norm(weight-original_weight)/torch.linalg.vector_norm(original_weight)),"changed_elements":int(torch.count_nonzero(weight-original_weight))})
drop_edit(weight_name)
result = {"target_columns":selected_columns,"control_columns":control_columns,"control_selection":"Fixed greedy closest log-norm/log-loop-mean-absolute-activation; loop/reference ratio required within [1/1.1,1.1]; no outcome-based replacement.","control_matches":control_matches,"variants":variant_results,"active_edits_after_export":edited()}
